en: This is a vintage postcard with the words 'CARTE POSTALE' printed at the top, indicating it is French. The card contains handwritten correspondence in red ink on the left side and an address on the right. The address is to 'Monsieur Orrouet, Clerc de Notaire, Jouy-le-Châtel, Seine et Marne'. The printed information and the handwriting style suggest it is from the early 20th century.
